I didn't have any idea on week 1 so I made starbie as per guide but, now I want to create something for myself.  I am tired of writing stuffs manually in A4 Papers and all and if I just print it, it doesn't look like its handwritten. So the solution seems to be to create a machine that writes down the content on a A4 paper using a pen that I have. TL;DR model for handwriting machine
